name: Ai Cute! Kimi ni Koishiteru
original_name: 愛cute!　キミに恋してる
source:
Sakurai high school is built around a stone that used to be a guidepost for transportation. At school it becomes a place for confessions. When main character confesses by the monument, love cupid Chocolate appears. If he develops real love feelings, this love cupid can become human. Protagonist tries his best to get a girlfriend, but will his efforts be rewarded?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
樱井学园围绕着一块过去用于指引交通的路标石建造。进入学校后，这块石头成了人们告白的地点。主人公在纪念碑前告白时，爱神巧克力现身了。只要他萌生真正的爱情，这位爱神就能变成人类。主人公竭尽全力寻找女友，他的努力会有回报吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
